statement.source_mapping: /spec/source.txt: exact evaluator P, rounded evaluator Q, and prescribed envelope E are defined by list recursion in /workspace/Research/Submission.lean. The supporting /spec/support/Research/Common/FloatingPoint/Model.lean is copied unchanged to /workspace/Research/Common/FloatingPoint/Model.lean. No /spec/feedback.json was present; no statement revision was made. The theorem proof is temporary sorry scaffolding for the next role.

report.target_evidence: The explicit target Research.Horner.forward_error already asserts the universal requested absolute forward-error bound about the explicitly defined P, Q, and E at identical inputs. The constructions reproduce all three source recursions. No missing theorem composition or additional inequality is needed to obtain the requested final conclusion.

requirements.requirement: Prove the full forward-error theorem for every model, coefficient list, and real evaluation point.
requirements.evidence: Research.Horner.forward_error explicitly quantifies over every relative-error model, every finite real list, and every real x, including empty lists, and asserts the full requested error inequality.

requirements.requirement: Use the exact Horner recursion with zero for the empty list and coefficients in increasing degree order.
requirements.evidence: Research.Horner.P is defined by P([],x)=0 and P(a::tail,x)=a+x P(tail,x). The head is the constant coefficient, with subsequent coefficients in increasing degree order.

requirements.requirement: Evaluate each cons step using a rounded multiplication of x and the rounded tail, then a rounded addition of the coefficient.
requirements.evidence: Research.Horner.Q is defined by Q(model,[],x)=0 and Q(model,a::tail,x)=r(a+r(x Q(model,tail,x))). The inner call rounds the product with the recursively rounded tail; the outer call rounds the sum. Each cons step has exactly the two required rounding calls.

requirements.requirement: Define the stated error envelope using exact values and u, with the requested recurrence and base case.
requirements.evidence: Research.Horner.E is defined by E([],x,u)=0 and E(a::tail,x,u)=u |a+x v|+(1+u)(u |x v|+(1+u)|x| e), where v=P(tail,x) and e=E(tail,x,u). This is exactly the prescribed recurrence and uses only exact tail values, coefficients, x, and u.

requirements.requirement: Bound the absolute difference of the supplied rounded and exact evaluators by the supplied envelope.
requirements.evidence: The target directly asserts |Q(model,coefficients,x)-P(coefficients,x)|<=E(coefficients,x,u(model)), explicitly identifying the functions with the supplied recursions and linking the same list, point, and model parameter throughout.

requirements.requirement: Use the supplied relative-error model without additional smallness, sign, nonzero, or exact-arithmetic premises.
requirements.evidence: The target model requires only u>=0 and a total r satisfying, for each real z, existence of delta with |delta|<=u and r(z)=z(1+delta). There is no upper bound on u, no restriction on list length, and no sign, nonzero, representability, or exactness condition on the rounded computation. Exact real operations in P and E are the requested definitions.

limitations: This review compares the source and blind translated mathematical statements; it does not inspect Lean implementation or proof code.

direct_report.target_evidence: Research/Submission.lean:50-82 proves Research.Horner.forward_error: ∀ (model : Research.FloatingPoint.Model) (coefficients : List ℝ) (x : ℝ), |Q model coefficients x - P coefficients x| ≤ E coefficients x model.u. The only model assumptions are nonnegative u and the relative rounding law at Research/Common/FloatingPoint/Model.lean:15-19.

requirements.requirement: Use the exact Horner recursion with zero for the empty list and coefficients in increasing degree order.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:6-8 defines P [] x = 0 and P (a :: tail) x = a + x * P tail x, giving increasing degree order.

requirements.requirement: Evaluate each cons step using a rounded multiplication of x and the rounded tail, then a rounded addition of the coefficient.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:12-14 defines Q model [] x = 0 and Q model (a :: tail) x = model.round (a + model.round (x * Q model tail x)); precisely one rounded multiplication and one rounded addition occur per step.

requirements.requirement: Define the stated error envelope using exact values and u, with the requested recurrence and base case.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:17-22 defines E [] x u = 0 and the exact requested cons recurrence u * |a + x*v| + (1+u) * (u * |x*v| + (1+u) * |x| * e), where v = P tail x and e = E tail x u. E does not depend on Q or round.

requirements.requirement: Bound the absolute difference of the supplied rounded and exact evaluators by the supplied envelope.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:52 states |Q model coefficients x - P coefficients x| ≤ E coefficients x model.u. Lines 53-82 prove it by list induction using the multiplication estimate at 57-71 and addition estimate at 74-82; the nil case uses the actual definitions.

requirements.requirement: Use the supplied relative-error model without additional smallness, sign, nonzero, or exact-arithmetic premises.
requirements.evidence: Research/Common/FloatingPoint/Model.lean:15-19 supplies only u, u_nonneg, round, and the universal relative rounding law. Research/Submission.lean:25-44 derives the perturbation bound from these fields; forward_error at 50-52 has no further hypotheses. The model is satisfiable (u=0 and round the identity). Independent #print axioms reports only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.
